6.337 rsRecursiveAggregateOfAggregate
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsRecursiveAggregateOfAggregate is a critical error that will occur when an aggregate function
specifies a value for the Recursive parameter and references another aggregate function inside the
Expression parameter.
